tiers.name: Novice
tiers.bane: Regression: -2 to all rolls until end of next turn. Nothing else.

tiers.name: Seasoned
tiers.bane: All above + a Complication (narrative obstacle - not a second mechanical penalty).

tiers.name: Veteran
tiers.bane: All above + one context-based Condition (GM selects). Combat physical: Prone or Stunned. Caster interrupted: Silenced or Drained (1 level). Stealth failure: Exposed. Social loss: Charmed or Fascinated. Movement failure: Slowed. Resist failure vs mental: Confused (1 round).

tiers.name: Heroic
tiers.bane: All above + resource waste (Stamina or Mana spent on the triggering Action is lost this scene). GM may apply a second Condition if fiction strongly supports it. Suggested pairings: Prone + Exposed; Silenced + Drained; Slowed + Frightened. Never three from one Bane.

tiers.name: Legendary
tiers.bane: All above + enemy makes one free Reaction attack immediately. Plus one typed Effect at 1-box potency at no pool cost - the Bane pays it. Fire: Burning. Necrotic: Drained 1. Psychic: Frightened or Charmed. Toxic: Poisoned. Void: Exposed + pool drain. Dark power: Doomed 1.

creation.bonus_skill_overlap: If a bonus skill is already a Focus Skill, +1 to any other skill instead.

advancement.role_advancement: At each tier change: advance a Role you hold by one Step, or begin a new Role at Step 1.
advancement.focus_skill_swap: At each tier change you may replace one Focus Skill with another.
advancement.governing_ability: Any of the nine. Can be changed once per tier with GM approval.
advancement.feat_slot_note: Each slot takes a Feat of its Rank or any lower Rank (DECISIONS.md).

initiative.roll: d20 + the primary Domain's Deflect Ability (+ Reputation when opponents know the character)

methods.name: Roll
methods.text: d20 + primary Domain Deflect Ability. Ties: higher Deflect Ability, then roll again.

methods.name: Pick Your Place
methods.text: Pick from 30, 26, 22, 18, 14, 10, continuing down in fours. No duplicates.

methods.name: Roll and Swap
methods.text: Everyone rolls as normal, then the table swaps numbers freely.

deflect: 10 + the Domain's Deflect Ability (Agility, Acuity, Serenity), plus armor/shield DR where it applies.

boon_menu.name: Recovery
boon_menu.effect: Unmark 1 box from any one pool

boon_menu.name: Tempo
boon_menu.effect: One additional Action this round (Seasoned tier and above)

boon_menu.name: Guard
boon_menu.effect: +2 to Deflect and Defend until your next turn

boon_menu.name: Grace
boon_menu.effect: Give any one of the above to an ally in Near range instead of taking it yourself

effects_rule: The Surge level sets an Effect's strength (Surge 2 = 1-box intensity). No separate Effect cost. A non-Signature Effect is -1 to the roll. Pay from the pool you are using.
costs_rule: Basic Attack, Basic Cast and Basic Press are free. Anything added costs at least 1 box. Maneuvers: Mastery Floor by tier. Surge: not reduced except by Surge Discipline.

wealth_tiers.name: Destitute
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Survival mode. Homeless or completely cut off from resources.

wealth_tiers.name: Poor
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Day-to-day survival. No savings. Basic needs barely met.

wealth_tiers.name: Struggling
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Working class. Functional but stretched. No financial cushion.

wealth_tiers.name: Average
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Stable income. Modest gear. Needs covered, small savings possible.

wealth_tiers.name: Comfortable
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Professional class. Good equipment, socially respected.

wealth_tiers.name: Wealthy
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Elite. Resources rarely a constraint. Doors open by default.

wealth_tiers.name: Very Wealthy
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Significant personal fortune. Institutional leverage available.

wealth_tiers.name: Filthy Rich
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Unlimited resources. Access is the only constraint.

quality.name: Improvised
quality.implement: A borrowed symbol, a sigil scratched in dirt

pool_transfer.text: Once per encounter, as a free action, spend boxes from any pool to restore boxes in any other at 2 for 1. Most boxes spent: 6 at Novice, rising by 2 per tier (6 / 8 / 10 / 12 / 14).

boon_rule: A Boon always gives Momentum: +2 to all rolls until the end of your next turn at Novice, lasting one extra turn per tier. From Seasoned you also choose from the Boon Menu (tier boon_choices).

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.effect: +2 to all rolls, until the end of your next turn at Novice and one turn longer per tier. Every Boon gives it; it is no longer a Boon Menu choice.

regression.name: Regression
regression.effect: The -2 to all rolls from a Bane (natural 1), until the end of your next turn. The same at every tier.
